# Requirement

- Requirement ID: REQ-501
- Title: Add transaction category filtering
- Source: Phase 3C STANDARD complete run demo
- Date: 2026-08-15

## Objective

Add a reusable function that filters transaction rows by category.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Exact category match returns matching rows.
- Unknown category returns an empty list.
- Empty category input returns all rows.
- Category filtering does not mutate input rows.
